newsitem.title: BELARUS: China vice-premier to visit Belarus in early April.
newsitem.headline: China vice-premier to visit Belarus in early April.

text.p: China's Vice Premier Wu Bangguo will pay a state visit to the former Soviet republic of Belarus early next month, the Belarussian foreign ministry said on Wednesday.
The April 2-3 visit would include meetings with President Alexander Lukashenko and Prime Minister Sergei Ling, a press spokesman for the ministry said.
Lukashenko has suggested forming a Russia-China-Belarus alliance to counter eastward expansion of the Western NATO military alliance, an idea opposed by Moscow and Beijing.

The only foreign leader to have visited Belarus since Lukashenko won a controversial referendum last November is Ukrainian President Leonid Kuchma, who met Lukashenko near the border in the town of Gomel.
Belarussian relations with many countries have grown increasingly rocky since the polls, with the United States in particular slamming its leadership for its human rights record.
Belarus and China have signed import-export and education agreements and paid several visits to each other since opening relations five years ago. Lukashenko visited China in 1995.
